title: Spoken Dialogue System for Medical Prescription Acquisition on Smartphone: Development, Corpus and Evaluation
reasoning: The paper describes a medical prescription system explicitly designed to improve patient safety, prevent adverse drug events (ADEs), and ensure the appropriateness of prescriptions. These objectives directly address core ethical considerations in healthcare. The system's functionality includes checks for drug interactions, contraindications, and patient history, which are all critical aspects of medical ethics and patient welfare.
